justification: Changes which rules a heritage lot is served (a zone filter), the nightly alarm's stored baseline, and four public coverage flags; no database write.

pre_impl.existing_data: The panel file's baselines held counts only; regulatory_provisions rows are read, never written
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A served rule with no integer id would be invisible to the comparison, so it is counted and fails the check
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All 28 existing baselines were re-recorded with rule ids; a baseline without ids now fails

functions.name: shape
functions.input: the route response dictionary for one panel address
functions.output: totals, councils, chapters and packed rule ids per chapter
functions.if_none: a missing data or by_layer key yields zero rules, which judge reports as served 0 rules

functions.name: judge
functions.input: the panel entry and the shape served now
functions.output: a list of reasons the address is outside its baseline
functions.if_none: no baseline or a baseline without rule ids returns a reason, never an empty pass

functions.name: queryHeritageByHca
functions.input: database client and the property filters including zone
functions.output: heritage rows limited to the property zone or to no zone limit
functions.if_none: with no zone filter supplied the query is unchanged from before

queries.purpose: heritage rules for a heritage property
queries.where_clause: current actionable heritage rows, HCA tag, council, precinct, and now ZONE_APPLIES_SQL
queries.if_zero: the condition layer shows only the site-condition rules
queries.if_wrong: rules for another zone are shown to this lot

break_it.scenario: One rule is swapped for another and the count stays the same
break_it.what_happens: A count-only alarm would stay green while the answer changed

break_it.scenario: A heritage lot in a business zone is served residential-zone heritage rules
break_it.what_happens: Wrong-zone rules appear under site conditions
break_it.how: route.ts zone filter in queryHeritageByHca; heritage-query test

break_it.scenario: A changed baseline is accepted without anyone knowing which rules changed
break_it.what_happens: A wrong rule could be accepted unnoticed
break_it.how: history records added and removed ids on each re-record and requires a reason

break_it.scenario: A zone-undecided rule with an empty zone array is dropped by the new filter
break_it.what_happens: A heritage rule would disappear silently
break_it.how: ZONE_APPLIES_SQL keeps NULL, empty and ALL; production comparison shows only the nine tagged rows changed

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any panel address is served five or more rules added or removed against its recorded ids
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Run against production before this merge it printed FAILED for 012 with 9 rules added (204912-204913, 204975, 205057, 205061-205063, 205073, 205102), the exact residential-zone rows the filter removes; against the preview build it passed 28 of 28

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: after the Vercel deploy run both data-watch scripts and expect exit 0
